claims.text: Filter by % Adj.
claims.note: The filter is set from the "% ADJ." link and tests each station's suggested percent adjust (sa-dashboard.component.ts:791). The dialog's own instruction reads "Filter % Adj. by setting an Over and/or Under threshold." (SPATIAL_ADJUST.FILTER_CFG_INSTRUCTIONS).

claims.text: Find the outliers at both ends before you push.
claims.note: One filter tests both ends at once.

claims.text: The Over/Under filter finds the extremes at both ends at once.
claims.note: With both ends enabled, a station is caught if its suggestion is above Over or below Under. When one end is disabled, that side falls back to a value no suggestion reaches (9999 for Over, 0 for Under), and the filter catches the other end only.

claims.text: It is not a range, and reading it as one will mislead you.
claims.note: The test is an OR of two strict comparisons, so the stations it shows lie outside the band, not inside it.

claims.text: Table toolbar
claims.note: The tabs and the filter link are the first item in the table toolbar (#sa-dit-toolbar) above the station table. The rest of that toolbar holds the applied target profile name and the Calculation ET readout (sa-dashboard.component.html:30-33).

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The guide starts on the dashboard with no dialog open; every dialog here opens only on a user action. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Reworded from dashboard-overview/before/1.

claims.text: The filter reads the suggested percentage, and only for stations that are enabled.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The test reads suggestedAdjAmtPercent, the calculated suggestion (sa-dashboard.component.ts:597), not the value typed into % Adj., so editing a station does not move it into or out of the filter. Disabled areas and holes are skipped as well as disabled stations (:771, :774, :790). On production saShowCurrentOnly is true (environment.toro-prod.ts:87), so a station is tested only when its scan is from today or its value is estimated (sa-dashboard.component.ts:789). A stale station under Option 1, which shows a dash in % Adj. (sa-table-card.component.html:51-62), is never caught.

claims.text: A disabled station is never caught by its own number, however extreme; it appears only as part of a paired row whose enabled partner is caught.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (filter-adjustments/before/2); docs/text-corrections.md §29 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: A disabled station never appears in it however extreme its number.

claims.text: Read the two tabs
claims.note: Two tabs: All Stations and Over/Under.

claims.text: Find the [[All Stations]] and [[Over/Under]] tabs above the table.
claims.note: All Stations and Over/Under are the two tabs above the table. Reworded from filter-adjustments/1/1, filter-adjustments/1/5.

claims.text: [[All Stations]] shows the full count, and [[Over/Under]] shows how many stations the filter catches.
claims.note: Over/Under carries the count of stations the filter catches. Reworded from filter-adjustments/1/2, filter-adjustments/1/3.

claims.text: If [[Over/Under]] shows a dash, no filter is set yet, or no station matches it.
claims.note: The tab shows a dash when the count is 0 or no filter is set (filteredStationsCount || '--', sa-table-threshold-filter.component.html:15). Reworded from filter-adjustments/1/4, filter-adjustments/verify/2.

claims.text: The next steps set one.
claims.note: The next steps open the options and set the filter. Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/1.

claims.text: Two tabs: All Stations, and the Over/Under count.
claims.note: Figure caption. The labels are CASE_SENSITIVE.ALL_STATIONS "All Stations" and SPATIAL_ADJUST.FILTER_OVER_UNDER "Over/Under", each with its count. The Over/Under tab also carries an over/under icon.

claims.text: Open the options
claims.note: The filter link toggles the Over/Under Options dialog.

claims.text: Select the link below the tabs, to the right of [[Bulk Adjust]].
claims.note: The filter link is below the tabs, beside Bulk Adjust. Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/2.

claims.text: [[Over/Under Options]] opens, with an [[Over]] value and an [[Under]] value.
claims.note: The Over/Under Options dialog has Over and Under values. Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/4, filter-adjustments/3/1.

claims.text: If a tip about selecting stations appears, you chose [[Bulk Adjust]].
claims.note: Bulk Adjust shows a tooltip, "Select one or more stations using the row checkboxes to enable bulk adjustment.", while no station is selected (sa-table-threshold-filter.component.html:18-29; en-us.json:380; sa-table-threshold-filter.component.ts:95-98).

claims.text: Select the link to its right.
claims.note: The Over/Under link sits to the right of Bulk Adjust. Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/5, filter-adjustments/2/1.

claims.text: Once a filter is set, the link shows the thresholds in force, so you can read it without opening it.
claims.note: The link reads the thresholds in force. Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/3, filter-adjustments/2/5.

claims.text: The link doubles as a readout of the current thresholds.
claims.note: The text is rebuilt from the saved thresholds and shows only the ends that are enabled.

claims.text: Set the two ends independently
claims.note: Over and Under each have a checkbox and a number input.

claims.text: Tick [[Over]], [[Under]] or both.
claims.note: Each end has its own tick box. Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/4, filter-adjustments/3/6.

claims.text: Each ticked end takes a value: [[Over]] from 0 to 300, default 200, and [[Under]] from 0 to 100, default 10.
claims.note: Over takes 0 to 300 (default 200); Under 0 to 100 (default 10). Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/2, filter-adjustments/3/3.

claims.text: If a value box stays grey, its end is not ticked.
claims.note: A value box is disabled until its end is ticked (sa-cfg-threshold-dlg.component.html:23-28, :43-52). Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/4.

claims.text: Tick it, then type the value.
claims.note: Tick the end, then enter the value. Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/4.

claims.text: Use [[Over]] alone to find stations asking for far too much, or [[Under]] alone for almost nothing.
claims.note: Either end can run on its own. Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/4, filter-adjustments/summary/1.

claims.text: Over/Under Options.
claims.note: Figure caption. Under the header the dialog reads "Filter % Adj. by setting an Over and/or Under threshold." It saves with "Save Changes" (SPATIAL_ADJUST.SAVE_CHANGES) and closes with Cancel.

claims.text: Each threshold has its own checkbox.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Exclude Zeros belongs to Under
claims.note: The checkbox sits in the Under block of the dialog.

claims.text: Tick [[Exclude Zeros]] below [[Under]] if you want to hide true zeros.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros sits below Under. Reworded from filter-adjustments/5/1, filter-adjustments/5/5.

claims.text: Stations suggesting 0 drop out of the filter, and those asking for a little stay.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros drops stations suggesting 0 and keeps those asking for a little. Reworded from filter-adjustments/5/3.

claims.text: If [[Exclude Zeros]] is greyed out, tick [[Under]] first.
claims.note: Exclude Zeros is disabled until Under is on. Reworded from filter-adjustments/5/5, filter-adjustments/5/2.

claims.text: Exclude Zeros is disabled until Under is on.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Not the same setting. Settings › Minimum Threshold has its own Exclude Zeros.
claims.note: Settings has a Minimum Threshold tab (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:54). Its Exclude Zeros checkbox sits under the option "Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx", and is enabled only with that option and a non-zero threshold (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:156-170).

claims.text: That one changes what gets written to Lynx at push time.
claims.note: With "Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx" chosen, a pending station whose % Adj. is below the threshold is raised to it at push time. Exclude Zeros leaves stations at 0 alone (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:448-452). The substitution is made on the push dialog's copy when the push is sent (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:74-79).

claims.text: This one only changes which rows you are looking at.
claims.note: The Over/Under Exclude Zeros is read only by the filter (sa-dashboard.component.ts:792). It is not part of what is pushed.

claims.text: Save the filter
claims.note: The dialog footer carries Save Changes and Cancel (sa-cfg-threshold-dlg.component.html:76-79). Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/5.

claims.text: Select [[Save Changes]].
claims.note: Save Changes is a footer button (sa-cfg-threshold-dlg.component.html:76-79). Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/5.

claims.text: A message confirms the thresholds were saved, and the link below the tabs shows them.
claims.note: Saving stores the thresholds and the link then shows them (sa-cfg-threshold-dlg.component.ts:95-117). Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/2, filter-adjustments/2/5.

claims.text: If you select [[Cancel]], nothing changes.
claims.note: Cancel closes the dialog without saving (sa-cfg-threshold-dlg.component.html:76-79).

claims.text: Open the options again to set them.
claims.note: The options open again from the link. Reworded from filter-adjustments/2/1.

claims.text: Your thresholds are saved for you alone, not for the site.
claims.note: The thresholds are saved to the user preferences. Reworded from filter-adjustments/5/4.

claims.text: Over/Under Options, with Save Changes and Cancel at the foot.
claims.note: Over/Under Options has Save Changes and Cancel at the foot. Reworded from filter-adjustments/3/5.

claims.text: It catches both extremes, not a band
claims.note: The comparison is an OR across the two ends.

claims.text: Select the [[Over/Under]] tab.
claims.note: The Over/Under tab applies the filter. Reworded from filter-adjustments/1/3, filter-adjustments/1/5.

claims.text: The table lists the stations above [[Over]] or below [[Under]], and none in between.
claims.note: A station is caught if above Over or below Under. Reworded from filter-adjustments/4/2, filter-adjustments/1/3.

claims.text: If you expected a range, read it again: 200 and 10 show everything over 200% and everything under 10%.
claims.note: With 200 and 10 the filter catches everything over 200 and everything under 10. Reworded from filter-adjustments/4/3, filter-adjustments/2/3.

claims.text: These are the stations worth a second look before a push: those about to get a great deal of water, and those about to get almost none.
claims.note: These are the stations worth a second look before a push. Reworded from filter-adjustments/4/7.

claims.text: The filtered tab: the extremes at both ends, not the middle.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Over/Under tab renders the filtered list as a flat table (showFlatFilteredList).

claims.text: You can state that the filter is an OR across both ends, not a range.
claims.note: Achievable from the guide.

claims.text: You know the Over/Under count reads as a dash until a filter is set.
claims.note: True until a filter is set. A set filter that catches nothing also shows a dash (see filter-adjustments/1/4).

claims.text: You know which Exclude Zeros changes the push and which only changes the view.
claims.note: Achievable from the guide.
